caseName: Humphrey v. Committee on Professional Ethics & Conduct of the Iowa State Bar Ass'n
caseNameFull: Humphrey, dba Humphrey & Haas v. Committee on Professional Ethics and Conduct of the Iowa State Bar Assn.

opinions.text:
Appeal from Sup. Ct. Iowa dismissed for want of substantial federal question.

Justice White, Justice Blackmun, and Justice Stevens would note probable jurisdiction and set case for oral argument.
